subject: Remove unused repl_offset_time field in clusterNode (#2198)
reason: The change deletes the clusterNode.repl_offset_time field, its zero-initialization in createClusterNode, and its single assignment in clusterProcessPacket. The field was only ever written, never read — a grep of the post-change tree shows no remaining references, and the pre-change code had no reader either (the PR title says 'Remove unused field'). clusterNode is an internal in-memory struct, not part of the cluster bus packet format or any persisted state, so removing the field changes no reply, no failover decision, no manual-failover offset handling (sender->repl_offset is still updated),
